Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.p1: Your privacy is very important to us. We are committed to protecting your personal information and your right to privacy.
Privacy.p2: We only collect information that you voluntarily provide to us when using the platform, including anonymous stories and materials.
Privacy.p3: We do not share your data with third parties without your explicit consent, except as required by law.

Terms.title: Terms of Use
Terms.p1: By using the Truth.Info platform, you agree to these terms. The platform is designed for sharing verified information and factchecking.
Terms.p2: Users agree not to publish knowingly false information, spam, or materials that violate the law.
Terms.p3: The administration reserves the right to moderate, modify, or remove any content that violates community guidelines.

Cookie.title: Cookie Policy
Cookie.p1: We use cookies to improve our website and enhance user experience.
Cookie.p2: Cookies help us analyze traffic, remember your language preferences, and theme settings (light/dark).
Cookie.p3: You can disable cookies in your browser settings, but this may affect the functionality of some site elements.
